A '''prototype Imperial starship''' was accidentally scrapped on the junk [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Axxila/Legends|Axxila]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vel (Moff)|Vel]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] hired scavengers to recover the starship, and launched an investigation afterwards.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Throwing Out Diamonds}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
With Game Update 4.1, the mission was made available to both factions, and Vel was referred to as faction-ambiguous "Admiral Vel."
